Use a CDN service, even a free one like CloudFlare

CDNs only let you deliver static content efficiently. Apart from thumbnails (which would be a slight offload), subverse CSS and the site's default assets, Voat doesn't have any mentionable amount of that.

You need a cloud service like Amazon AWS or Microsoft Azure that actually lets you run your web app on a lot of app servers to handle huge numbers of parallel requests.
